digest.component_or_area: bridge CLI / reconciler engine / request normalization
propositions: Canonical `rebar bridge preview` and `rebar bridge sync` must become primary CLI routes while retaining legacy `rebar reconcile` and `--mode` argument compatibility with documented defaults and numeric behavior unchanged.

Legacy `--filter-local-ids` continues post-differ write filtering; canonical `--only`/`--except` must narrow differ inputs before differs run, with unresolvable tokens or mid-scan selection disappearance exiting 2 before lock/mutation.

Direct-engine argument-less calls and Python library `rebar.reconcile(mode=...)` must remain callable with historical live/dry-run defaults and reconcile-check gating behavior while request normalization unifies all paths into shared core.
`--max-changes` as explicit positive cap must apply deterministic partition manifests for capped live runs (e.g. 10/92, 100/2, 102/0) while uncapped live and legacy bootstrap retain prior behavior.

Production workflow must use canonical vocabulary for mapped operations while retaining lock-free `reconcile-check` diagnostic path; older checked-out workflow revisions must invoke the retained legacy adapter.

Legacy external-DC helper, pressure-test scripts, and all existing compatibility consumers must remain unchanged; ADR 0092 and generated index must record the expand-contract adapter rationale and pass current ADR numbering checks.
